items.name: Stir-Fried Pork with Abalone and Chilli
items.description: Prepared with premium Hunan native pork, Hunan chilli peppers, and abalone from Fujian. Fresh ingredients, wok-tossed over a high heat for a savoury, aromatic dish, a must-order at every table.

items.description: Crispy-Tender Chicken with Fragrant Dried Chili — Spicy & Crunchy

items.name: Dry Pot Celtuce with Chinese Preserved Pork

items.description: Prepared with premium Hunan pork belly, firm yet tender in texture with a deep, savoury aroma. Perfectly balanced between fat and lean, rich and indulgent.

items.name: Claypot Pork Intestine with Pickled Mustard Greens & Pig's Blood Curd
items.description: After 27 years, this is the flavour worth the wait. Authentic Hunan-style claypot of pork intestine and pig’s blood curd, slow-braised for rich savoury depth and bold aroma.

items.name: Claypot Pork Trotter with Baby Corn
items.description: Braised until tender and flavourful, featuring rich collagen and a deep savoury taste in every bite.

items.name: Claypot Home-style Tofu
items.description: Silky soft tofu simmered in a rich and savoury house-made sauce, delivering a smooth, flavourful taste. Perfect with a bowl of rice.

items.name: Claypot Mixed Mushrooms
items.description: A selection of fresh mushrooms slow-braised with sliced pork belly to enhance natural sweetness, delivering a rich umami aroma and layered, satisfying flavour.

items.description: Handmade Pork Balls — Glutinous Rice Wrapped Around Fresh Meat & Salted Egg Yolk, Soft and Richly Flavored

items.description: Sweet-tangy tomatoes with silky eggs, quickly stir-fried for a fresh and appetizing taste

items.name: Yangzhou Fried Rice
items.description: Wok-fried with ham, sweet corn and egg, delivering a fragrant savoury flavour and rich wok hei in every bite.

items.name: Big Shrimp with Vermicelli and Garlic
items.description: Tender Jumbo Shrimp with Garlic — Steamed to Perfection, Rich & Fragrant

items.name: Sweet and Sour Chicken with Pineapple
items.description: Crispy Tender Chicken Strips with Sweet Pineapple — Savory, Aromatic & Refreshingly Tangy

items.name: Organic Steamed Egg with Minced Pork

items.name: Beancurd Skin with Eggs

items.name: Braised Beef Brisket with Organic Radish Claypot
items.description: Tender, slow-braised beef brisket with sweet, flavorful radish in a rich and savory broth

items.description:
Premium white loofah imported from Hunan, China, naturally sweet and refreshing.
Slow-braised with Baby Abalone, allowing the natural umami to fully infuse into the dish for a light, savoury finish.

items.name: Mapo Tofu with Fish Maw
items.description: Fragrant, spicy, and numbing with a tender, silky texture.

items.name: Spicy Chicken Offals
items.description: Flash stir-fried over high heat, delivering a tender bite with vibrant tangy spice and fragrant aroma

items.name: Stir Fry Smoked Bamboo Shoots
items.description: A comforting, authentic home-style favourite. Made with premium Hunan native pork, rich in aroma and flavour. Stir-fried over a high heat with tender bamboo shoots for a crisp texture and savoury taste.

items.name: Steamed Fish Head with Chopped Chili
items.description: Fish Head from Dongjiang Lake, Hunan — Steamed with Chopped Hunan Chili, Tender, Spicy & Flavorful

items.name: Dry Pot Stir-Fried Pork Belly with Tea Tree Mushrooms
items.description: Crispy pork belly with tender tea tree mushrooms, dry-pot stir-fried for rich flavor

items.name: Lotus Root with Superior Pork Broth
items.description: A timeless bowl that is good for the soul. Slow-simmered with sweet lotus root and tender, flavourful premium Hunan native pork ribs. The broth is clear, savoury, and nourishing.

items.name: Dry Pot Hand-Torn Cabbage
items.description: Wok-fried over high heat, delivering a fragrant, crisp texture with rich wok hei

items.name: You-Mai Lettuce with Shredded Seasoned Mud Carp
items.description: Irresistible wok hei, delivering rich savory flavors that pair perfectly with rice.

items.name: Stir-fried green dragon vegetable with bean sprouts
items.description: Stir-fried green dragon vegetable with bean sprouts, crisp and naturally sweet.

items.name: Stir-Fried Cauliflower
items.description: Stir-fried over high heat, fresh and tender with a crisp, refreshing bite
